kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic مُعْتَزِلَة (muʕtazila)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic معتزلي
From مُعْتَزِلَة (muʕtazila, “the Mu'tazila”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
g: Mu'tazili, Mu'tazilite (of or relating to the Mu'tazila)
